themes.label: Regulating tech oligarchs controlling AI
themes.definition: Speaker attacks the concentration of power in 'tech oligarchs' controlling social networks and AI development and calls for strict regulation of them.
themes.inclusion: Include calls to regulate or curb powerful tech companies or individuals controlling AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general governance calls not targeting corporate or state concentration of power.
themes.boundary_cases: Calls for strict regulation of AI firms also warrant AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE if framed internationally.

examples.quote: We must impose strict regulations on the tech oligarchs who control the functioning of social networks and the development of artificial intelligence.

themes.label: Developing countries participating in AI governance
themes.definition: Developing countries must actively participate in the governance and development of AI and emerging technologies.
themes.inclusion: Include demands that developing countries take part in AI governance or development.
themes.exclusion: Exclude access-only complaints without participation demands.
themes.boundary_cases: A brief one-line demand in a list of reform priorities still counts here.

examples.quote: Developing countries must actively participate in their governance and development.

value.rationale: Both 2026 passages mention AI briefly within broader UN-reform speeches: Spain targets tech oligarchs controlling AI for strict regulation, while Timor-Leste demands developing-country participation in AI governance.
